from.place: Tag 08EE proof: lift a quasi-coherent derived object from the quasi-compact open

title: Quasi-coherent derived objects lift across a quasi-compact open of an affine scheme
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U be a quasi-compact open subscheme, and let E be an object of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category]. There exists E' in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) whose restriction to U is isomorphic to E.

source.place: Tag 08EE proof, invocation of Lemma lemma-lift-quasi-coherent

proof.text: Let j:U\hookrightarrow X be the open immersion. It is quasi-compact: if W\subseteq X is affine open, then j^{-1}(W)=U\cap W; writing U=U_1\cup\dots\cup U_n with U_i affine (U is quasi-compact), each U_i\cap W is affine because the affine scheme X is separated, so U\cap W is quasi-compact. It is quasi-separated, since every open immersion is separated. For E in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U), define E'=Rj_*E. The derived direct-image preservation theorem [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] applied to the quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism j gives E' in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X).

source.place: Tag 08EE proof, invocation of Lemma lemma-lift-quasi-coherent; Lemma 08D5(1)

proof.text: The restriction-comparison isomorphism [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open], applied with f=j and the open V=U\subseteq X, has j^{-1}(U)=U and induced morphism g=\mathrm{id}_U, so it gives (Rj_*E)|_U\cong R(\mathrm{id}_U)_*(E)=E. Thus E'|_U\cong E, proving the assertion.
